mapper.select: SELECT nr.id, nr.notice_id, nr.teacher_id, nr.is_received, nr.is_todo, nr.confirm_time, n.title, n.content, n.publish_time, n.publisher_id, n.publisher_type, COALESCE(n.notice_type, '教学通知') as notice_type, COALESCE((SELECT t2.dept FROM TEACHER t2 WHERE t2.teacher_id = n.publisher_id), n.publish_dept, '院办') as publish_dept, COALESCE(n.attachments, '[]') as attachments, COALESCE(n.status, 'published') as notice_status, COALESCE(n.publisher_name, CASE WHEN n.publisher_type = 'teacher' AND t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN n.publisher_type = 'admin' AND a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username WHEN t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username ELSE '未知' END ) as publisher_name, COALESCE(t2.name, '') as teacher_name, t2.dept as teacher_dept FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE nr LEFT JOIN NOTICE n ON nr.notice_id = n.notice_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON n.publisher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON n.publisher_id = a.admin_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t2 ON nr.teacher_id = t2.teacher_id

SELECT nr.id, nr.notice_id, nr.teacher_id, nr.is_received, nr.is_todo, nr.confirm_time, n.title, n.content, n.publish_time, n.publisher_id, n.publisher_type, COALESCE(n.notice_type, '教学通知') as notice_type, COALESCE((SELECT td.dept FROM TEACHER td WHERE td.teacher_id = n.publisher_id), n.publish_dept, '院办') as publish_dept, COALESCE(n.attachments, '[]') as attachments, COALESCE(n.status, 'published') as notice_status, COALESCE(n.publisher_name, CASE WHEN n.publisher_type = 'teacher' AND t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN n.publisher_type = 'admin' AND a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username WHEN t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username ELSE '未知' END ) as publisher_name, COALESCE(t2.name, '') as teacher_name, t2.dept as teacher_dept FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE nr LEFT JOIN NOTICE n ON nr.notice_id = n.notice_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON n.publisher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON n.publisher_id = a.admin_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t2 ON nr.teacher_id = t2.teacher_id WHERE nr.id = #{id}

SELECT nr.id, nr.notice_id, nr.teacher_id, nr.is_received, nr.is_todo, nr.confirm_time, n.title, n.content, n.publish_time, n.publisher_id, n.publisher_type, COALESCE(n.notice_type, '教学通知') as notice_type, COALESCE((SELECT td.dept FROM TEACHER td WHERE td.teacher_id = n.publisher_id), n.publish_dept, '院办') as publish_dept, COALESCE(n.attachments, '[]') as attachments, COALESCE(n.status, 'published') as notice_status, COALESCE(n.publisher_name, CASE WHEN n.publisher_type = 'teacher' AND t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN n.publisher_type = 'admin' AND a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username WHEN t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username ELSE '未知' END ) as publisher_name, COALESCE(t2.name, '') as teacher_name, t2.dept as teacher_dept FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE nr LEFT JOIN NOTICE n ON nr.notice_id = n.notice_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON n.publisher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON n.publisher_id = a.admin_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t2 ON nr.teacher_id = t2.teacher_id WHERE nr.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE_RECEIVE (notice_id, teacher_id, is_received, is_todo, confirm_time) VALUES (#{notice.noticeId}, #{teacher.teacherId}, #{isReceived}, #{isTodo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{confirmTime})

mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE_RECEIVE SET notice_id = #{notice.noticeId}, teacher_id = #{teacher.teacherId}, is_received = #{isReceived}, is_todo = #{isTodo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, confirm_time = #{confirmTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT nr.id, nr.notice_id, nr.teacher_id, nr.is_received, nr.is_todo, nr.confirm_time, n.title, n.content, n.publish_time, n.publisher_id, n.publisher_type, COALESCE(n.notice_type, '教学通知') as notice_type, COALESCE((SELECT td.dept FROM TEACHER td WHERE td.teacher_id = n.publisher_id), n.publish_dept, '院办') as publish_dept, COALESCE(n.attachments, '[]') as attachments, COALESCE(n.status, 'published') as notice_status, COALESCE(n.publisher_name, CASE WHEN n.publisher_type = 'teacher' AND t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN n.publisher_type = 'admin' AND a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username WHEN t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username ELSE '未知' END ) as publisher_name FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE nr LEFT JOIN NOTICE n ON nr.notice_id = n.notice_id LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON n.publisher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON n.publisher_id = a.admin_id WHERE nr.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND nr.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_received = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as readCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_received = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unreadCount FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}

SELECT nr.teacher_id as teacherId, t.name as teacherName, t.dept as teacherDept, nr.is_received + 0 as isReceived, nr.is_todo + 0 as isTodo, nr.confirm_time as confirmTime FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE nr LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON nr.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE nr.notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY nr.is_received ASC, t.name ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE_RECEIVE SET remind_count = COALESCE(remind_count, 0) + 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND is_received = 0
